_meta.source: KPWD SR 2023-24 Vol 2, Addendum II (CBRI Roorkee) — 'Material and labour required on plinth area basis', residential buildings
_meta.verified: Transcribed from the rendered printed pages, not just the extracted text
_meta.formula: quantity = a × A + b, where A = total plinth area of all storeys in m²
_meta.valid_range: 30-300 m² of plinth area (one dwelling) for single and double storey load-bearing buildings (Note I, page 229)
_meta.excluded_by_source: Builder's hardware, rainwater goods, water supply, plumbing, drains and electrical wiring are to be added extra (Note I)

omitted_rows.lime, surkhi: Lime-surkhi mortar; modern work uses cement mortar, which the cement row covers
omitted_rows.bitumen: Replaced by the modern roof waterproofing finished item 15.11
omitted_rows.brick aggregate: Not used with M-Sand / crushed aggregate
omitted_rows.shuttering ballies: Formwork is added as a percentage per Vol 1 (Preface item 22) — not in Vol 2
omitted_rows.four storey (RCC-framed) column: Valid only up to 100 m² total plinth area and contains A² terms that turn negative beyond it (e.g. steel = 102.46A − 0.401A² − 1662); also printed with a typo ('397A − 0.76' for sand). Buildings of 3+ storeys use the double-storey column, flagged approximate.

rows.note: Constant printed as '66/8'; read as 66.8 (double storey constant is 63)
